headline: Gas Prices Have Nearly Doubled in a Year. What the Ministry of Energy Says About the Risk of a Crisis in Romania
summary: Romania is in a better position than other European states for the cold season, a Ministry of Energy state secretary said. Gas prices have nearly doubled in a year, but there are no grounds to expect a crisis for the population.
why: Natural gas prices and supply security feed directly into household bills, industrial costs and European energy policy.
